title:
CHAIN
OF COMMAND
body:
Move the [ICON: white symmetric silhouette with a tall narrow central spike and two shorter outward-curving side lobes] by 1 space in any direction.

OR

COMMAND
Choose a Character with a lower Rank.
Then, Move, Shoot, or Burst using this
Character.
